newsitem.title: USA: UCAR to file for 6.8 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: UCAR to file for 6.8 mln share offer.

text.p: UCAR International Inc on Monday said it planned to file a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission related to a public offering of 6.8 million share by certain shareholders.
Shares are being sold by Blackstone Capital Partners II Merchant Banking Fund LP, Blackstone Offshore Capital Partners II LP and Blackstone Family Investment Partnership II LP, the company said.
The company, the world's largest maker of graphite and carbon electrodes, said it would repurchase from Blackstone about 10 percent of the shares set to be sold in the offering.
Upon closing of the offering and the share repurchase, Blackstone would not own any common UCAR stock, apart from shares retained for certain Blackstone partners, UCAR said.
The company said it would not receive any proceeds from the offering.
UCAR said it estimated certain Blackstone partners would retain about 966,000 shares, though that number could increase.
UCAR would finance stock repurchases from existing cash balances, cash flow from operations and borrowings under its revolving credit facility, it said.
